body:
## Sub-issue of #853 — Part 2: bundled CJK font, language picker and locale preference

**Proposal, asking for a yes before any code lands.** Follow-up to the closure of #3304.

### What

- Bundle the Noto Sans SC 400 subset (GB2312 + punctuation, OFL 1.1, ~2.2 MB) under `assets/ui/fonts/`, with `OFL.txt`, the `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` entry and `scripts/fonts/subset_sc.py`.
- Load the face from `crates/ui/src/egui_app/fonts.rs` so Chinese glyphs render.
- Persist a `language` BCP 47 tag in `ViewPrefs` (`crates/app/src/prefs.rs`), absent = follow the system locale; a malformed tag produces a status note and keeps the rest of the file.
- Add the View door's **Language** list: live switch, generated from `Lang::ALL`, persisted to `prefs.json` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs`).
- Read `CAMCRAFT_LANG` and the system locale at startup; an unknown tag stays English.

### Why this part second

It depends only on Part 1's registry and needs no call-site changes. A reviewer can check the font licence, the preference migration and the picker independently of any translation work.

### Not in this part

No translated strings, no `tr()` call sites, no catalogue additions.

### Acceptance

- The shipped font's `cmap` covers every string in `zh-CN.toml` (structural test).
- Switching language in the View door changes the preference file; restart preserves it; `CAMCRAFT_LANG` overrides for one run.
- Posted output and project files are byte-identical in every language setting.

### Depends on

Part 1 (i18n core).
